entries.description: Publish a short text status update to the current user's profile feed.

prompts.first: Post a status update on my profile that says: "Happy birthday, Mia! 🎂"
prompts.second: Please update my feed with this status: "ありがとう、みんな 🙏"
prompts.both: Can you make two separate status posts on my profile? The first one should say "Happy birthday, Mia! 🎂" and the second one should say "ありがとう、みんな 🙏".

distractor.name: send_direct_message
distractor.description: Send a private direct message to a specific user, rather than posting to the public feed.

entries.name: post_status_update

text.description: The text of the status update, which may include emoji and non-Latin characters.

entries.description: Start a new countdown timer with a duration in whole minutes. Each call creates a separate timer that runs independently of any others.

prompts.first: Start a 25 minute timer for my study session, please.
prompts.second: Can you start a 10 minute timer? I'm boiling pasta.
prompts.both: I need two separate timers running at the same time: start one for 25 minutes for my study session, and start another one for 10 minutes for the pasta I'm boiling.

distractor.name: list_active_timers
distractor.description: List all countdown timers that are currently running, along with their remaining time, without creating or changing any timers.

entries.name: start_countdown_timer

duration_minutes.description: Length of the timer in whole minutes.

entries.description: Apply a temperature calibration offset (in degrees Celsius) to a smart thermostat sensor so its readings match a reference thermometer.

prompts.first: My living room thermostat reads a bit low compared to my kitchen thermometer. Can you set its calibration offset to 2 degrees Celsius?
prompts.second: The bedroom thermostat is running warm. Please apply a calibration offset of -0.75 °C to it.
prompts.both: Please calibrate my two thermostats: set a +2 °C offset on the living room one since it reads low, and set a -0.75 °C offset on the bedroom one since it runs warm.

distractor.name: set_target_temperature
distractor.description: Set the target temperature that the thermostat should heat or cool the room to.

entries.name: set_thermostat_offset

offset_celsius.description: Calibration offset in degrees Celsius to add to the sensor reading. Negative values lower the reading.

entries.description: Start a new export of the user's mailbox as a downloadable archive. Each call queues a separate export job.

prompts.first: Please start a mailbox export without attachments. I only need the message text, so keep the archive small.
prompts.second: Please start a mailbox export and include the attachments too.
prompts.both: Please queue two separate mailbox exports: one without attachments, as a small text-only archive, and another one that includes all the attachments, as a full archive.

distractor.name: schedule_mailbox_backup
distractor.description: Set up a recurring automatic backup of the user's mailbox on a daily, weekly, or monthly schedule.

entries.name: export_mailbox

include_attachments.description: True to include file attachments in the exported archive, false to export only message text and headers.

entries.description: Clears the due date on a project so it no longer has a deadline. The deadline field must be explicitly set to null to confirm the removal.

prompts.first: Please remove the deadline from the project so it has no due date anymore. Set the deadline to null.
prompts.second: The client has put the launch on hold indefinitely, so clear the project's deadline. It should just be null, no date.
prompts.both: I need two deadline removals done as separate calls. First, clear the deadline for the project (set it to null). Second, do the same thing again as its own call, also clearing the deadline to null.

distractor.name: set_project_deadline
distractor.description: Sets a new due date for a project using a calendar date.

entries.name: clear_project_deadline

deadline.description: Must be null to indicate the project's deadline is being removed.

entries.description: Send a single test page to the user's default printer to check alignment and print quality.

prompts.first: The edges look cut off when I print wide spreadsheets. Can you print a test page in landscape orientation so I can check the margins?
prompts.second: I just replaced the toner cartridge. Please print a test page in portrait orientation so I can check the print quality.
prompts.both: I'm setting up my new printer and want to check both layouts. Please print two separate test pages: one in portrait orientation and one in landscape orientation.

distractor.name: set_paper_size
distractor.description: Change the default paper size used by the user's printer, such as A4 or Letter.

entries.name: print_test_page

orientation.description: The page orientation to use for the test page.

entries.description: Pause all currently active ad campaigns under one of the connected ad accounts.

prompts.first: Please pause all the active campaigns on ad account 106254871930264. The holiday promo ended and we don't want to keep spending.
prompts.second: Can you pause every running campaign under ad account 108837402915583? We're doing an audit on it.
prompts.both: Two things: pause all active campaigns on ad account 106254871930264, and also pause all active campaigns on ad account 108837402915583. Both are done for the quarter.

distractor.description: Resume all paused ad campaigns under one of the connected ad accounts.

entries.name: pause_ad_account_campaigns

entries.description: Estimate the total print time for the currently loaded 3D model using one of the slicer's supported layer height presets.

prompts.first: How long would the model I have loaded take to print at a 0.2 mm layer height?
prompts.second: Can you estimate the print time for the loaded model if I slice it at 0.12 mm layers?
prompts.both: I'm trying to decide on quality settings for the loaded model. Please run one print time estimate at 0.2 mm layer height and a separate one at 0.12 mm so I can compare them.

distractor.name: set_print_speed
distractor.description: Set the target print speed in millimetres per second for the current slicing profile.

entries.name: estimate_print_time

entries.description: Turn off marketing email notifications for the current user's account. Only opting out is supported; the flag must be false.

prompts.first: Please stop sending me marketing emails. I'm tired of the promos clogging my inbox.
prompts.second: Can you opt my account out of marketing emails? I don't want any more newsletters or promotional offers.
prompts.both: I have two accounts with you and want to stop promo emails on both. Please opt out of marketing emails for this account, and then do the same again for my other account so each one gets its own opt-out.

entries.name: disable_marketing_emails

entries.description: Remove the current assignee from a support ticket so it returns to the unassigned queue. The assignee field must be explicitly set to null.

prompts.first: Please unassign the current ticket so it goes back into the unassigned queue. Set the assignee to null.
prompts.second: Nobody should own this support ticket anymore. Clear the assignee (null) so it drops back to the unassigned pool.
prompts.both: I need to unassign two tickets. For the one I'm looking at, clear the assignee to null. Then do a separate call to clear the assignee to null on the other ticket I have open, so both go back to the unassigned queue.

distractor.name: assign_ticket

entries.name: clear_ticket_assignee

assignee.description: Must be null to unassign the ticket.

entries.description: Trigger a refresh of the store's currency exchange rates from the configured upstream rate provider.

prompts.first: Can you sync our exchange rates from the ECB feed? The checkout prices look stale.
prompts.second: Please refresh the currency rates using the ECB as the source.
prompts.both: Run the exchange rate sync from the ECB twice, as two separate calls. I want to compare the sync timestamps afterward to make sure the rates are stable.

entries.description: Apply a calibration offset to a smart thermostat's temperature sensor, in tenths of a degree Celsius. Only the factory-approved offset value is accepted.

prompts.first: My living room thermostat reads too warm. Please apply the standard sensor calibration offset of -25 tenths of a degree Celsius.
prompts.second: The bedroom thermostat is also reading high. Set its sensor calibration offset to -25 (tenths of a degree C), the approved correction value.
prompts.both: Both of my thermostats read too warm. Please make two separate calibration calls, one for the living room unit and one for the bedroom unit, each with the approved sensor offset of -25 tenths of a degree Celsius.

entries.name: set_thermostat_offset

entries.description: Set the sentinel value that the weather data import pipeline treats as a missing sensor reading.

prompts.first: Our station files use -9999 for missing readings, so please set the missing data sentinel to -9999.
prompts.second: Set the import pipeline's missing-value sentinel to -9999 so gaps in the sensor data get flagged properly.
prompts.both: I'm about to import two batches, one from the coastal stations and one from the mountain stations. Please make two separate calls to set the missing data sentinel to -9999, one for each batch.

distractor.name: set_import_date_range
distractor.description: Set the start and end dates of the observations that the weather data import pipeline should load.

entries.name: set_missing_data_sentinel

entries.description: Permanently deletes the user's account after they explicitly confirm the irreversible action. The confirmation flag must be true for the request to be accepted.

prompts.first: I've decided to close my account for good. I understand everything will be permanently erased and can't be recovered, so please go ahead and delete it.
prompts.second: Yes, I'm sure. Please delete my account and all my data permanently. I know this can't be undone and I confirm it.
prompts.both: I have two accounts I want gone: my personal one and the one I made for my side business. I understand deletion is permanent and I confirm it for both. Please run the deletion confirmation once for the personal account and once for the business account, as two separate requests.

entries.name: confirm_account_deletion

entries.description: Removes the monthly spending limit from the card currently selected in the wallet app, so the card has no cap. The limit field must be explicitly null to confirm removal.

prompts.first: Please take the monthly spending limit off my selected card so there's no cap on it anymore.
prompts.second: I don't want a monthly cap on the card I have open right now. Can you clear the spending limit completely?
prompts.both: Clear the monthly spending limit so there's no cap, and do it as two separate calls: one for my personal card and one for my business card. The app applies it to whichever card is selected at the time.

entries.name: remove_card_spending_limit

entries.description: Send raw input to the active interactive terminal session, exactly as given, including any control characters.

prompts.second: In my open vim terminal session, please send `:wq` followed by a single newline character (like pressing Enter) so vim saves and quits. Send it as one input.

prompts.second: Log a stock adjustment of -120 for the product I have open. That's the batch we had to write off after the water damage.
prompts.both: For the product I have open, I need two entries in the adjustment log: one for +37 units from today's delivery, and a separate one for -120 units written off after the water damage.

entries.name: record_stock_adjustment

entries.description: Fill every cell in a selection the user has made in their spreadsheet with the same value. The value can be a number, text, boolean, or any other JSON value. Call it once per selection and value; each call writes a single value.

prompts.second: With the selection I have on the Q3 forecast sheet, please put 18.5 in every selected cell.
prompts.both: Please fill two selections for me, using one fill call for each. The selection in my 'Adjustments' sheet should be filled with -0.75, and the selection in my 'Forecast' sheet should be filled with 18.5. They're separate, unrelated fills, so don't combine them into a single call.

entries.name: fill_selected_cells

The user may manage several accounts (for example personal and work), and each account has its own independent setting. When the user asks for changes on different accounts, make one separate call per account in the same turn; the calls do not override each other.

prompts.first: I'm back from vacation, so please turn off do-not-disturb on my account. I want my notifications again.
prompts.second: I'm heading into a deep work block, so please turn on do-not-disturb for my account.
prompts.both: I have a personal account and a work account, and their do-not-disturb settings are independent, so I need two separate calls, not one. Call one is for my personal account: I'm back from vacation, so turn do-not-disturb off. Call two is for my work account: I'm starting a focus session, so turn do-not-disturb on. Please make both calls now.

prompts.second: Remove the delivery note from the order I'm editing, set it to null so it's empty.

entries.description: Set or clear the permanent hold on a smart thermostat. Each call updates exactly one thermostat. prompts.first: Please remove any gate access details saved on the order I have open. I don't want the courier to have a gate code anymore.
prompts.second: Clear the gate code for my current delivery. Set the gate access to null, since the building now has a staffed front desk.
prompts.both: I have two orders open in separate windows. In the first one, clear the saved gate access details, and do the same in the second one. Neither needs a gate code now.

distractor.name: update_delivery_address
distractor.description: Change the street address, unit number, or postal code for the delivery on the current order.

entries.name: set_gate_access

gate_access.description: Gate access details for the courier, or null to clear any saved details.

code_expiry.description: Must be null; gate codes saved here do not expire automatically.

access_code.description: Keypad or gate code the courier should use.

entries.description: Set or clear the delegate who can approve requests on behalf of the current user. Pass null to remove the existing delegate, or an object with the delegate's username to assign one.

prompts.first: I'm back from vacation, so please remove my approval delegate. I don't want anyone approving requests for me anymore.
prompts.second: Clear whoever is currently set as my approval delegate so that nobody is covering my approvals.
prompts.both: Please remove my approval delegate, so nobody covers for me. Then make a second, separate call that clears the delegate again, because I want two clear entries in the audit log.

distractor.name: list_pending_approvals
distractor.description: List the approval requests currently waiting for the user's decision, optionally filtered by status or requester.

entries.name: set_approval_delegate

delegate.description: The colleague who will approve on the user's behalf, or null to clear the delegate.

entries.description: Set or clear the automatic reorder rule for a product in the inventory system. Pass null to disable automatic reordering, or an object with the reorder point to enable it.

prompts.first: Please turn off automatic reordering for our bamboo desk organizer. We're discontinuing it, so there should be no reorder rule at all.
prompts.second: Clear the auto-reorder setting for the stainless steel water bottle, I don't want any reorder rule on it anymore. Set it to null.
prompts.both: We're winding down two products: the bamboo desk organizer and the stainless steel water bottle. Please clear the auto-reorder rule on both of them (null, no reorder rule), as two separate updates.

distractor.name: adjust_stock_quantity
distractor.description: Manually adjust the on-hand stock quantity of a product after a count, delivery, or write-off.

entries.name: set_stock_reorder_rule

auto_reorder.description: Automatic reorder configuration. Null disables automatic reordering for the product.

reorder_point.description: Stock level (in units) at which a new purchase order is triggered

entries.description: Set or clear a temporary temperature override on a smart thermostat. Passing null clears any active override and returns the thermostat to its normal schedule; passing an object applies a manual target temperature.

prompts.first: Please cancel the temporary temperature override on the thermostat so it goes back to its regular schedule.
prompts.second: I bumped the heat manually earlier and want that undone. Clear the thermostat override and let the schedule take over again.
prompts.both: I have two thermostats to reset, so please make two separate calls to clear the override on each one, the downstairs one and the upstairs one. Both should just go back to their normal schedule with no override.

distractor.name: get_thermostat_status
distractor.description: Retrieve the current temperature reading, mode, and active schedule for a smart thermostat without changing any settings.

entries.name: set_thermostat_override

override.description: The manual override to apply, or null to clear the current override.

entries.description: Set or clear the temporary override for a user's notification quiet hours. Pass null to clear any existing override and return to the regular schedule, or an object to apply an override.

prompts.first: I turned on a quiet hours override on my phone earlier this week, but I don't need it anymore. Please clear it so I'm back on my normal notification schedule.
prompts.second: Can you remove my temporary quiet hours override? Set it to nothing so my regular schedule applies again.
prompts.both: Please do two things for me: clear the quiet hours override on my personal account, and also clear the quiet hours override on my work account, so both go back to their regular schedules.

distractor.name: update_quiet_hours_schedule
distractor.description: Update the recurring daily start and end times for a user's notification quiet hours schedule.

entries.name: set_quiet_hours_override

override.description: The quiet-hours override to apply, or null to clear the current override.

enabled.description: Whether quiet hours are forced on (true) or forced off (false) for the override.

entries.description: Mute or unmute push notifications for the signed-in user's account. Pass null to remove any active mute. Pass an object with expires_at set to null to mute indefinitely until the user turns it off.

prompts.first: I'm back at my desk, so please unmute my notifications. I don't want any mute active anymore.
prompts.second: Can you take the mute off my notifications? I want them fully back on, with no mute of any kind.
prompts.both: Please clear the mute on my notifications so they're back on. Then make a second, separate call that clears the mute again, just to be sure it stuck.

distractor.name: set_quiet_hours
distractor.description: Configure the recurring daily quiet-hours window during which notifications are silenced, using a start and end time of day.

entries.name: set_notification_mute

mute.description: Null clears the mute and turns notifications back on. An object with expires_at null mutes notifications with no end time.

expires_at.description: Always null, meaning the mute has no expiry.

entries.description: Configure the outbound HTTP proxy used by the current API client session. Pass null to disable the proxy and connect directly, or an object with the proxy URL to route requests through it.

prompts.first: My requests keep timing out because of the corporate proxy. Please turn the proxy off for this session so it connects directly.
prompts.second: Clear the proxy setting for the current session, I don't want any proxy in use right now.
prompts.both: I want to double-check that disabling the proxy is idempotent. Please make two separate calls to the proxy setting tool, each one setting the proxy to none, so direct connections are used.

distractor.name: test_proxy_connection
distractor.description: Check whether a given proxy server is reachable and measure its latency without changing any session settings.

entries.name: set_session_proxy

anyOf.description: No proxy; connect directly.

proxy.description: Proxy configuration for the session, or null to disable.

entries.description: Set or remove the cap on guest seats in the current workspace. Pass null to remove the cap, or an object with max_seats to enforce a limit.

prompts.first: We've outgrown the guest seat cap on our workspace. Please remove the guest seat limit entirely so it's unlimited.
prompts.second: Can you clear the guest seat limit for this workspace? I don't want any cap on guests anymore.
prompts.both: Please remove the guest seat limit for this workspace so it's unlimited. Then make a second, separate call that clears the limit again, so I can confirm in the audit log that the setting stays at no cap.

distractor.name: get_workspace_usage

entries.name: set_guest_seat_limit

guest_seat_limit.description: Null removes the guest seat cap; an object sets a maximum number of guest seats.

max_seats.description: Maximum number of guest seats allowed

entries.description: Set or remove the daily spending limit on the user's card account. Pass null to remove the limit, or an object with the maximum daily amount to set one.

prompts.first: Please remove the daily spending limit on my card. I don't want any cap on it anymore.
prompts.second: Can you turn off my daily spending limit? Set it to no limit at all.
prompts.both: I want my daily spending limit removed. Make one call to clear it with no limit, then make a second separate call that also sets it to no limit, so I can see the confirmation come back twice.

distractor.name: get_spending_summary
distractor.description: Retrieve a summary of the user's recent card spending, grouped by category.

entries.name: set_daily_spending_limit

limit.description: The daily spending limit. Null means no limit.

amount.description: Maximum amount allowed per day, in the account currency

entries.description: Set or clear the temporary mute override for the signed-in user's notifications. Pass null to remove any existing override and return to the normal notification schedule, or an object to apply an override.

prompts.first: Please remove my temporary mute override so my notifications go back to the normal schedule. Just clear it, with no override set.
prompts.second: I don't want the mute override on my account anymore. Set the override to null so everything goes back to normal.
prompts.both: Clear my notification mute override, setting it to none. Then make a second, separate call that also clears it to none, because the first one sometimes doesn't sync to my phone.

distractor.name: get_notification_settings
distractor.description: Retrieve the signed-in user's current notification preferences and any active mute override without changing them.

entries.name: set_mute_override

override.description: The override to apply, or null to clear the current override.

muted.description: Whether notifications are muted while the override is active.

entries.description: Pause or resume the user's email digest notifications. Pass null to clear any pause and resume digests; pass an object with a null resume_at to pause them indefinitely until the user resumes manually.

prompts.first: Please clear the pause on my email digests so they start arriving again. Set the pause to none.
prompts.second: My digests are still on hold from last month. Remove the pause entirely (set it to null) so I get the daily summary emails again.
prompts.both: I'm double-checking the resume behavior. Make two separate calls to the digest pause setting, each one clearing the pause (null) so digests are active, back to back.

distractor.description: Change how often the user receives email digests, such as daily or weekly.

entries.name: set_digest_pause

resume_at.description: Must be null: the pause has no automatic end time.

pause.description: null clears the pause; an object with resume_at null pauses digests indefinitely.

entries.description: Set or clear the delivery instructions attached to an existing customer order. Pass null to clear any saved instructions, or an object to set them.

prompts.first: Please clear the delivery instructions on my current order. I don't want any special instructions on it anymore.
prompts.second: Remove whatever delivery instructions are saved for my order, just set them to none.
prompts.both: I need to clear delivery instructions twice: once for my home-address order and once for my office-address order. Please make two separate calls, each setting the instructions to null.

distractor.name: update_shipping_address
distractor.description: Change the shipping address on an existing customer order.

entries.name: set_delivery_instructions

delivery_instructions.description: Delivery instructions for the order, or null to clear them.

note.description: Free-text note for the courier.

entries.description: Configure the low-stock alert for a product. Pass null to clear any existing alert rule, or an object with an optional reorder threshold to set one.

prompts.first: Please clear the low-stock alert rule for our warehouse inventory item. I don't want any alert set at all, so set it to null.
prompts.second: Remove the low-stock alert on this product, I want no alert rule configured anymore. Just set the rule to null.
prompts.both: I need two alert rules cleared in the inventory system. Make one call that sets the low-stock alert rule to null, and make a separate second call that also sets the low-stock alert rule to null, so neither has any alert configured.

distractor.description: Adjust the on-hand stock quantity for a product in the warehouse inventory.

entries.name: set_inventory_alert

reorder_threshold.description: Number of units at or below which the alert fires

entries.description: Set or clear the manual temperature override on the currently selected thermostat. Pass null to clear the override and return to the normal schedule, or an object to apply an override.

prompts.first: Please clear the manual temperature override on my thermostat so it goes back to its normal schedule.
prompts.second: I bumped the heat by hand earlier. Can you remove that override and let the thermostat follow its regular schedule again? Set the override to none.
prompts.both: Clear the manual temperature override on my thermostat so it goes back to the schedule. Then make a second, separate clear-override call as well so I can see two entries in the activity log.

distractor.name: get_current_temperature
distractor.description: Read the current room temperature and humidity from the selected thermostat.

entries.name: set_temperature_override

entries.description: Capture a screenshot of the user's current browser tab. Pass null for options to use the default capture settings.

prompts.second: Please take a screenshot of the page I'm on right now. Just the standard defaults, so no options at all (null).
prompts.both: I need two separate screenshots of my current tab. For each one, don't set any options (null), just use the default settings.

distractor.name: list_screenshots
distractor.description: List previously captured screenshots saved in the user's gallery.

entries.name: capture_screenshot

full_page.description: Capture the entire scrollable page instead of just the visible area.

entries.description: List open support tickets from the helpdesk queue, optionally restricted by an assignee filter.

prompts.first: Can you pull up all the open tickets in the helpdesk queue? I don't want any assignee filter, so leave the filter as null.
prompts.second: List every open support ticket for me, across all assignees. No assignee filter at all, just null for that.
prompts.both: I want to compare the queue before and after the nightly sync. Please run the open-ticket listing twice as two separate calls, each with the assignee filter set to null so nothing is filtered out.

entries.description: Set or clear the automatic out-of-office reply for the user's email account. Pass null to turn the auto-reply off, or an object to configure it.

prompts.first: I'm back from vacation, so please turn off the out-of-office auto-reply on my account. Just clear it, no replacement message.
prompts.second: Please disable my automatic out-of-office reply. Set it to null, I don't need any message there anymore.
prompts.both: Can you make two calls to clear the out-of-office auto-reply setting? One for my work mailbox and one for my personal mailbox. In both cases set the auto-reply to null so it's turned off.

distractor.name: send_email
distractor.description: Compose and send an email message to one or more recipients.

entries.name: set_out_of_office_reply

auto_reply.description: Auto-reply configuration, or null to disable the auto-reply.

message.description: Text of the auto-reply message.

prompts.second: I don't want a custom auto-save setting anymore. Set my override to null so the workspace default applies.

entries.name: set_autosave_override

entries.description: Print a test page on the connected printer, optionally shifting the page margins to check alignment.

prompts.first: Can you print a test page on the office printer? Use the default margins, so no margin adjustment (null).
prompts.second: Please send a test page to the printer. I don't want any margin adjustment, so leave it as null.
prompts.both: I need two separate test pages printed, each as its own print request. For both of them use the default margins, so the margin adjustment should be null.

entries.name: print_test_page

entries.description: Update a user's notification settings. Pass null for the settings to leave preferences unchanged, or an object to apply specific overrides.

prompts.first: Please run the notification preferences update for my account, but don't change any of my email settings. Set the email overrides to null.
prompts.second: I'm opening the notification settings for my team workspace and want to leave the email overrides cleared. Send the update with email overrides as null so nothing changes.
prompts.both: Can you make two notification preference updates for me? For my personal account, set the email overrides to null, and do the same for my work account, with email overrides null too, so neither one changes.

distractor.name: send_test_email
distractor.description: Send a test notification email to a user to verify delivery.

entries.name: update_notification_preferences

email_overrides.description: Email notification overrides, or null for no changes

entries.description: Set or clear the snooze state for the current user's push notifications. Pass null to clear any active snooze and resume notifications.

prompts.first: I'm back at my desk, so please turn off my notification snooze and let notifications come through again.
prompts.second: Clear the snooze on my push notifications. I don't want it snoozed anymore, so set it to none.
prompts.both: Please clear my notification snooze so it's set to none. Then make a second, separate call that clears it again, just so I can be sure it stays off.

entries.name: set_notification_snooze

entries.description: Set or clear the remarks attached to the checkout currently open for the user. Pass null to remove any existing remarks, or an object with the remark text under the Japanese field label to set new remarks.

prompts.first: I don't want any note on the order I'm checking out right now. Please clear the remarks on it so it's empty.
prompts.second: Can you remove whatever remarks are on my current checkout? I'd like it to have no note at all, just set it to nothing.

call_forwarding.description: Whether incoming calls are forwarded to the backup number.

away_message.description: Away message shown or played to callers. Empty string clears it.

preferences.away_message: 📵 Offline until Monday, please call the main office

entries.description: Create a new ticket in the helpdesk. The ticket details are given as a combination of assignment, summary and escalation settings.

prompts.first: Please open a new helpdesk ticket saying "Printer on the 3rd floor is jammed again". Don't assign it to anyone, and escalate it right away.
prompts.second: Can you create a ticket for "Request for a new laptop charger for onboarding"? Leave it unassigned and don't escalate it.
prompts.both: I need two new helpdesk tickets, both left unassigned. The first is "Printer on the 3rd floor is jammed again" and it should be escalated immediately. The second is "Request for a new laptop charger for onboarding" and it should not be escalated.

distractor.name: update_ticket_status
distractor.description: Change the status of an existing helpdesk ticket, for example from open to resolved.

entries.name: create_support_ticket

assignee.description: Must be null so the ticket goes to the unassigned queue for triage.

summary.description: Short description of the problem or request.

escalate.description: Whether to flag the ticket as escalated right away.

ticket.summary: Printer on the 3rd floor is jammed again
Request for a new laptop charger for onboarding

entries.description: Store free-form custom metadata on the CRM contact currently open in the workspace. Accepts an arbitrary JSON object of key/value pairs, including nested objects and arrays.

prompts.first: Please update the contact's custom metadata. I want a billing_preferences entry that contains invoice_po_number set to null (no PO number) and paperless set to false, plus an account_note that says "Prefers email contact".
prompts.second: Save this on the contact's metadata under the key import_row: a list with five items in this order: "Acme Corp", an empty string, "Berlin", null, and "net-30".
prompts.both: I need two metadata updates on contacts. For the first, set metadata with a billing_preferences entry containing invoice_po_number as null and paperless as false, plus an account_note reading "Prefers email contact". For the second, set metadata with an import_row key holding a list of five items in order: "Acme Corp", an empty string, "Berlin", null, and "net-30".

distractor.name: search_contacts
distractor.description: Search the CRM for contacts by name, email, company, or city and return matching records.

entries.name: update_contact_metadata

metadata.description: Arbitrary custom metadata to attach to the contact, as key/value pairs.
